NUFORC UFO Sighting 187344

Occurred: 2025-01-29 02:00 Local
Reported: 2025-01-30 09:33 Pacific
Duration: 5 min
No of observers: 2 - Pilot

Location: Tremont, ME, USA
Location details: Looking from window of house out to trees across Goose Cove 310 Degrees Northwest of me

Shape: Orb
Color: Orange
Estimated Size: no idea
Viewed From: Land
Direction from Viewer: 310 NW
Angle of Elevation: 45
Closest Distance: 1 mile
Estimated Speed: over 100 MPH
Characteristics: Lights on object, Changed Colo

Watched Orbs fly across the tree line

We have been watching these Orbs since August. It is now a nightly occurrence to see these flying around. I do not make a report every time I see them because it is almost daily. I filmed them in October and December, when it was easier to get out and film. I have not since. In August we watched them each week go up from the trees and turn orange, blue, green and red and then they would turn dark. Some would fly straight up, some to the right and one to the left. They would come back later and look like aircraft with blinking white lights. They would line up and then stop in midair and go through a sequence of lights blinking. 8 or 9 in the middle and then 8 or 9 around the outside in an oval. Then they would continue to the trees and disappear. These fly in 30 to 40 knot winds. They fly in formation, erratically and also very fast. One time it appeared many were dropping into the atmosphere. It was not until the news started talking about the drones in NJ that we realized we were seeing similar things. My boyfriend is a pilot and says he has never witnessed this before.
